checks.text: An unknown barcode asks "Which medicine is it?" so the owner can link it once

shots.caption: An unknown barcode on the purchase form

notes: Linking the code once, so it is remembered, cannot be reached because the scan box on this screen does not respond to Enter (see feature 106). Once a code is linked, the counter does recognise it.
did: Typed a barcode the system has never seen into the scan box on the purchase form, expecting it to ask which medicine it belongs to.
